text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$104,325 to NT$91,489, but the intervening ups and downs do not show a predictable pattern; I should not treat recent moves as forecasts.","Because losses weigh on me more than equal gains, I should avoid making fear-driven decisions after declines and assess my holdings calmly.","I made no trades throughout these periods; I should continue to trade selectively, but review whether my holdings and cash fit my goals rather than letting inaction become automatic."]}
